answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared reef of collateral before it can trade in the open meadow of the marketplace. New identities start with zero trust and earn it only through slow, costly peer attestations; a whisper of suspicion from two independent attestors freezes withdrawals until a review clears it. Spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand stakes and climbing a thousand slow trust ramps, so a Sybil swarm pays far more than it can ever extract, while honest newcomers pay only time.
